AI & Data Science Student Handbook
This fictional document is created for our RAG practice project.
1. Program Overview
The Artificial Intelligence and Data Science program covers machine learning, data analysis,
software development, databases, and modern artificial intelligence.
2. Academic Requirements
Students should complete 120 ECTS credits for the full master's program. Required and elective
modules are completed according to the study plan.
3. Assessment

Assessment may include written examinations, presentations, programming assignments, projects,
and practical demonstrations.
4. Data Science
Typical topics include Python programming, data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis,
statistics, machine learning, model evaluation, and data visualization.
5. Artificial Intelligence
AI topics may include supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, natural language
processing, computer vision, generative AI, and intelligent systems.

6. Project Work
Students are encouraged to develop practical projects demonstrating problem formulation, data
preparation, model development, evaluation, documentation, and deployment.
7. Recommended Tools
Common tools include Python, Jupyter Notebook, Git, GitHub, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn,
PyTorch, and SQL.
8. Career Preparation
Students can prepare for internships and working-student positions by developing technical

projects, maintaining a GitHub portfolio, and practicing technical interviews.
Important: This is a fictional practice document and is not official university regulation.
